en.text: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

zhSimplified.text: 在耶路撒冷作王、大卫的儿子、传道者的言语。

zhTraditional.text: 在耶路撒冷作王、大衛的兒子、傳道者的言語。

en.text: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

zhSimplified.text: 传道者说：虚空的虚空， 虚空的虚空，凡事都是虚空。

zhTraditional.text: 傳道者說：虛空的虛空， 虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。

en.text: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

zhSimplified.text: 人一切的劳碌， 就是他在日光之下的劳碌，有什么益处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人一切的勞碌， 就是他在日光之下的勞碌，有甚麼益處呢？

en.text: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

zhSimplified.text: 一代过去，一代又来， 地却永远长存。

zhTraditional.text: 一代過去，一代又來， 地卻永遠長存。

en.text: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

zhSimplified.text: 日头出来，日头落下， 急归所出之地。

zhTraditional.text: 日頭出來，日頭落下， 急歸所出之地。

en.text: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

zhSimplified.text: 风往南刮，又向北转， 不住地旋转，而且返回转行原道。

zhTraditional.text: 風往南颳，又向北轉， 不住地旋轉，而且返回轉行原道。

en.text: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

zhSimplified.text: 江河都往海里流，海却不满； 江河从何处流，仍归还何处。

zhTraditional.text: 江河都往海裏流，海卻不滿； 江河從何處流，仍歸還何處。

en.text: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

zhSimplified.text: 万事令人厌烦， 人不能说尽。 眼看，看不饱； 耳听，听不足。

zhTraditional.text: 萬事令人厭煩， 人不能說盡。 眼看，看不飽； 耳聽，聽不足。

en.text: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

zhSimplified.text: 已有的事后必再有； 已行的事后必再行。 日光之下并无新事。

zhTraditional.text: 已有的事後必再有； 已行的事後必再行。 日光之下並無新事。

en.text: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

footnotes.text: 1:10 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 岂有一件事人能指着说这是新的？ 哪知，在我们以前的世代早已有了。

zhTraditional.text: 豈有一件事人能指着說這是新的？ 哪知，在我們以前的世代早已有了。

en.text: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

zhSimplified.text: 已过的世代，无人记念； 将来的世代，后来的人也不记念。

zhTraditional.text: 已過的世代，無人記念； 將來的世代，後來的人也不記念。

en.text: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 我传道者在耶路撒冷作过以色列的王。

zhTraditional.text: 我傳道者在耶路撒冷作過以色列的王。

en.text: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

zhSimplified.text: 我专心用智慧寻求、查究天下所做的一切事，乃知 神叫世人所经练的是极重的劳苦。

zhTraditional.text: 我專心用智慧尋求、查究天下所做的一切事，乃知上帝叫世人所經練的是極重的勞苦。

en.text: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

zhSimplified.text: 我见日光之下所做的一切事，都是虚空，都是捕风。

zhTraditional.text: 我見日光之下所做的一切事，都是虛空，都是捕風。

en.text: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

zhSimplified.text: 弯曲的，不能变直； 缺少的，不能足数。

zhTraditional.text: 彎曲的，不能變直； 缺少的，不能足數。

en.text: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

zhSimplified.text: 我心里议论说：我得了大智慧，胜过我以前在耶路撒冷的众人，而且我心中多经历智慧和知识的事。

zhTraditional.text: 我心裏議論說：我得了大智慧，勝過我以前在耶路撒冷的眾人，而且我心中多經歷智慧和知識的事。

en.text: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

zhSimplified.text: 我又专心察明智慧、狂妄，和愚昧，乃知这也是捕风。

zhTraditional.text: 我又專心察明智慧、狂妄，和愚昧，乃知這也是捕風。

en.text: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

zhSimplified.text: 因为多有智慧，就多有愁烦； 加增知识的，就加增忧伤。

zhTraditional.text: 因為多有智慧，就多有愁煩； 加增知識的，就加增憂傷。
